annotation.caveat: One reviewer (the implementing assistant), not expert consensus. Contamination: the reviewer had already seen detector event lists for both clips while building the pipeline, so the test split is NOT a blind test.
annotation.method: Manual review of raw decoded frames sampled every 0.4 s with only the zone outline drawn (no detector output shown). Intervals are visibility intervals rounded to 0.4 s.

headline: Measured on 2 CC0 source recordings plus generated fixtures. Descriptive only: far too small for statistical claims.

development.scope: 1 source recording(s): pedestrian_area. 2 annotated events across 2 evaluation units (1 negative). Real pixel inference with pretrained COCO weights.

notes: Fixture lane only: scripted observations, tagged source=fixture.

per_clip.purpose: one entry, one event, no repeat per frame
crossing under the 1.0 s dwell is suppressed
alternating boundary noise does not create an event
a gap longer than 0.4 s splits the occupancy and missed time does not count as dwell
stationary candidate for a supported object; people excluded
small jitter does not reset the window
one interval can satisfy two rules; both are kept as separate events
dwell is measured in seconds, not frames
events are not merged across different track IDs

fixture.scope: 12 generated scenarios with deterministic ground truth. Tests the temporal rules WITHOUT a detector; these numbers say nothing about real video.

test.scope: 1 source recording(s): rush_hour. 1 annotated events across 2 evaluation units (1 negative). Real pixel inference with pretrained COCO weights.

not_measured: Detection accuracy (mAP) and tracking metrics (ID switches): no ground-truth boxes or tracks were annotated.
Passage occupancy events on real footage: not annotated.
Retrieval Recall@k: not evaluated beyond functional tests of the query parser (no relevance-labelled query set).
Explanation quality: there is no explanation or VLM component.
Generalisation: two CC0 clips (one outdoor pedestrian scene, one traffic scene) cannot represent warehouses or indoor aisles.
Human review time and usefulness: no user study was done.
scope_warning: Two sources (goal was 12). One reviewer annotated from raw frames after seeing detector output on both clips while developing, so even the test split is not blind. Fixture-lane scores are about the temporal rules only. Every real-footage figure rests on 1 to 3 events; read the denominators, not the percentages.
sweep_note: Development clip only (one source). It describes how counts move with sampling and threshold; it cannot establish an optimum, and defaults were not changed on this basis.
